A canonical motile cilium (or eukaryotic flagellum) whose axoneme consists of nine peripheral microtubule doublets surrounding a central pair of singlet microtubules (the 9+2 arrangement). Conserved across Chlamydomonas reinhardtii, Tetrahymena thermophila, and Trypanosoma brucei, the 9+2 motile cilium integrates central pair projections, radial spokes, nexin-dynein regulatory complexes, and dynein arms to produce planar or ciliary waveforms. This corpus keeps the two apart because most sources do not. 3441 producer claims say a taxon makes the compound, and only 840 of those rest on evidence that addressed the organism. 2351 records carry a cited occurrence, which says only that someone found the compound there. Nothing promotes one to the other.
